description: MANDATE-28: su co KEO DAI 35 phut tren `cart`, va giua chung mot su co THU HAI no chong tren `recommendation` khi su co dau chua dut. Kiem ba thu cung luc: (1) bao xuyen suot su co dai, khong khoang cam; (2) khong bao gia vi tai nen dao dong; (3) su co 2 duoc bat va TACH RIENG chu khong bi su co 1 che. Hai su kien CO Y chong nhau — do la ly do do_inject phai chay theo lich chung thay vi tuan tu.
notes: CHUA CHAY DUOC TREN CUM — SSO het han 29/07. Bang chung offline nam o aiops/detector/test_sustained.py va aiops/test_timeline.py; chay that la buoc rieng, xem ADR-019.

VI SAO 2100s (35 phut) cho su co 1. Truoc khi co freeze, do duoc tren chinh eval_metric_rule: mot su co o muc duoi nguong SLO bi nuot sau ~9 phut (baseline 30 mau x poll 30s = 15 phut de bi keo len het). Kich ban phai dai HON han cua so do moi kiem duoc gi; 35 phut cho bien hon gap doi.

VI SAO su co 2 bom vao `recommendation` chu khong phai service khac. Ba dieu kien phai thoa cung luc: (a) khac service voi su co 1 de kiem duoc 'tach rieng'; (b) khong nam tren duong phu thuoc cua cart, neu khong thi giet no chi lam nang them chinh trieu chung cua su co 1; (c) frontend chiu duoc no chet ma van co loi do duoc. Theo aiops/topology.json thi frontend -> recommendation la canh dong bo truc tiep, va recommendation khong goi cart.

VI SAO su kien 2 bat o offset 1200 (phut 20). Phai nam TRON trong su co 1 (0-2100) va phai sau moc ~9 phut ma detector cu da bi nuot — de neu freeze khong hoat dong thi ca nay FAIL that chu khong FAIL vi ly do khac.

RANG BUOC BOM: hai su kien chong nhau khong duoc dung chung mot diem bom. Tat `cart` va tat `recommendation` la hai deployment khac nhau nen doc lap. Neu doi sang bom cung mot service thi lenh `off` cua su kien 1 se xoa luon loi cua su kien 2.
KHOI PHUC: ca hai `off` deu scale ve 2 = dung minReplicas cua HPA. Tong thoi gian mot lan chay: 2100 + 300 settle = 40 phut.
AN TOAN: `aiops-remediation` chay REMEDIATION_DRY_RUN=true va chi co policy cho oom-detected, nen no khong can thiep vao ca nay.
